info.title: ChatCLI AIOps Platform API
info.description:
REST API served by the ChatCLI operator — incidents, SLOs, runbooks, approvals, postmortems, remediations, AI insights, analytics, audit, clusters, federation, policies and health.

**Where it runs.** The API and the web dashboard share the operator's `api` port (default `8090`, Helm value `api.port`, env `CHATCLI_AIOPS_PORT`), exposed by the Service `chatcli-operator` in the operator namespace — not by an Instance Service. Plain HTTP by default; HTTPS (TLS 1.3) when `CHATCLI_AIOPS_TLS_CERT` and `CHATCLI_AIOPS_TLS_KEY` are set. Every operator replica serves it.

**Authentication.** Every `/api/v1/*` call needs the `X-API-Key` header (see the `ApiKeyAuth` scheme). Roles are `viewer` < `operator` < `admin`; each operation states its minimum role. A role below the minimum gets `403`.

**Rate limit.** 30 requests per minute per client host for requests without a valid API key, and 600 per minute per valid key (token buckets). Exceeding it returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds until the next token: 2 for the host limit, 1 for the key limit). The limit is applied before authentication.

**Envelope.** Lists return `{apiVersion, kind, metadata: {totalCount, page, pageSize}, items}`; single resources return `{apiVersion, kind, spec, status, resourceMeta}`; errors return `{apiVersion: "v1", kind: "Error", error: <HTTP status text>, code, message}`.

The playground uses **editable server variables** so you can point requests at your own operator (for example through `kubectl -n chatcli-system port-forward svc/chatcli-operator 8090:8090`).

servers.description: Self-hosted ChatCLI operator — adjust scheme, host, port and basePath to match your deployment.

scheme.description: `https` when the operator runs with CHATCLI_AIOPS_TLS_CERT / CHATCLI_AIOPS_TLS_KEY.

host.description: Host of the operator API. In-cluster: the Service `chatcli-operator` in the operator namespace (e.g. `chatcli-operator.chatcli-system.svc`). From a workstation: `localhost` with `kubectl port-forward svc/chatcli-operator 8090:8090`, or your Ingress host.

port.description: API/dashboard port. Default 8090; Helm value `api.port`, env var `CHATCLI_AIOPS_PORT`.

basePath.description: API base path. Always `api/v1` unless a proxy rewrites it.

tags.name: Incidents

get.description:
Lists Issue CRs as incidents, with optional filters and pagination. Filters are exact matches.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one incident. `spec` and `status` carry the same incident object.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists the RemediationPlans whose `spec.issueRef.name` equals the incident name. Returns an empty list (not 404) when there are none.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns the timeline stored in the incident's PostMortem (`status.timeline` of the PostMortem whose `spec.issueRef.name` matches). Returns 404 until a PostMortem exists for the incident.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

post.description:
Adds the annotations `aiops.chatcli.io/acknowledged=true`, `aiops.chatcli.io/acknowledged-at` (RFC3339) and `aiops.chatcli.io/acknowledged-by` (the caller's **role**, not a user name) to the Issue. No request body is read and the incident state does not change. The notification controller reads the acknowledgment: an escalation that has not started is not started, and a running one stops at its current level with no further level and no repeat. The acknowledgment is recorded as `acknowledgedAt` / `acknowledgedBy` on the escalation's entry in the EscalationPolicy `status.activeEscalations`. State-change notifications, such as Resolved, still go out.

Minimum role: `operator`.

Sets `status.state=Resolved`, `status.resolution` and `status.resolvedAt`, then adds the annotations `aiops.chatcli.io/resolved-by` (caller's role), `aiops.chatcli.io/resolved-at` and `aiops.chatcli.io/manual-resolution=true`. Returns 409 when the incident is already Resolved.

Minimum role: `operator`.

resolution.description: How the incident was resolved. Defaults to `Manually resolved via dashboard` when omitted.

example.resolution: Hotfix v2.4.1 deployed; memory stable for 15 minutes.

post.description:
Adds the annotations `aiops.chatcli.io/snoozed-until` (now + duration, RFC3339) and `aiops.chatcli.io/snoozed-by` (caller's role) to the Issue. The state does not change. Until `snoozed-until`, the notification controller sends no state-change notification except Resolved, and escalation holds its level: a level notification held back by the snooze goes out when it ends (annotation `platform.chatcli.io/escalation-pending-notify`) and the level's timeout restarts then. Remediation is not affected. A duration that is zero or negative returns 400.

Minimum role: `operator`.

duration.description: Go duration string (e.g. `30m`, `1h`, `2h30m`). Must be positive; no maximum is enforced.

get.description:
Lists Runbook CRs.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

post.description:
Creates a Runbook CR. `namespace` defaults to `default` and `maxAttempts` to 3. A Kubernetes API failure on create keeps its own status: 409 only when a runbook with that name already exists, 422 when the API server rejects the object (validation), 403 when the operator may not create it, and 500 otherwise.

Minimum role: `operator`.

example.name: oom-standard
example.description: Raise memory limits after an OOMKill, then restart.

422.description: The Kubernetes API server rejected the runbook (validation).

get.description:
Returns one Runbook.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

put.description:
Updates a Runbook. The body uses the create schema (`name` and `namespace` in the body are ignored — the path and query identify the runbook). `description`, `trigger` and `steps` are **replaced** by what the body carries (omitting them clears them); `maxAttempts` changes only when > 0; `labels` replace the existing labels only when present.

Minimum role: `operator`.

delete.description:
Deletes a Runbook. There is no in-use check.

Minimum role: `admin`.

get.description:
Lists ServiceLevelObjective CRs, projected to a flat item.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one SLO. `spec` and `status` carry the same flat SLO object.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns the error-budget view of one SLO. `burnRate` is the controller's 1-hour burn rate (`status.burnRate1h`). There is no history or forecast.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists ApprovalRequest CRs. A request without `status.state` is reported as `Pending`.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Exact match on the reported state.

get.description:
Returns one ApprovalRequest. `spec` and `status` carry the same flat approval object.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

post.description:
Records one approval decision on a `Pending` ApprovalRequest, the same way the `platform.chatcli.io/approve` annotation does: an entry in `status.decisions` with the approver, the reason and a timestamp. The handler never sets `status.state`; the ApprovalReconciler evaluates the decisions against the rule (`requiredApprovers`, change window) and moves the request to `Approved`, so the response usually still shows `Pending`. The approver is stored as `<approver> (api-key: <identity>)`, where the identity is the API key entry's `name`, else its `description`, else a `key-<hash>` fingerprint. A quorum counts distinct API keys, so a shared key cannot satisfy `requiredApprovers` of 2 or more. Returns 409 when the request is not `Pending` or the same key already decided on it.

Minimum role: `operator`.

example.reason: AI analysis confirms the memory bump is required.

post.description:
Records one rejection decision on a `Pending` ApprovalRequest, the same way the `platform.chatcli.io/reject` annotation does. The ApprovalReconciler then rejects the request (any rejection rejects, regardless of the change window) and the waiting RemediationPlan fails. The approver is stored as `<approver> (api-key: <identity>)`, as for approve. Returns 409 when the request is not `Pending` or the same key already decided on it.

Minimum role: `operator`.

example.reason: Prefer adjusting the HPA before raising limits.

get.description:
Lists PostMortem CRs with optional filters and pagination.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one PostMortem. `spec` and `status` carry the same postmortem object.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

post.description:
Sets `status.state=InReview` and `status.reviewedAt`. When `reviewer` is given it is stored in the annotation `aiops.chatcli.io/reviewed-by` (and `notes` in `aiops.chatcli.io/review-notes`); `notes` without `reviewer` is ignored.

Minimum role: `operator`.

example.notes: Root cause confirmed. Adding an action item for rate limiting.

post.description:
Stores developer feedback in `status.feedback` (with `providedAt`), replacing any previous feedback.

Minimum role: `operator`.

remediationAccuracy.description: Score 1-5 for the AI remediation accuracy.

overrideRootCause.description: Human-provided root cause overriding the AI analysis.

example.overrideRootCause: Leak caused by an uncancelled goroutine in the webhook handler.
example.comments: Good analysis. Suggest AdjustResources before restart next time.

post.description:
Acknowledges that the human follow-up for a Contained incident has been done (rollback, config fix, replicas restored). Sets the annotations `aiops.chatcli.io/human-action-acknowledged=true` and `aiops.chatcli.io/human-action-acknowledged-at`, plus `...-acknowledged-by` and `aiops.chatcli.io/human-action-note` when given, then clears `status.requiresHumanAction` so the PostMortem can be closed. Returns 400 when the PostMortem does not require human action.

Minimum role: `operator`.

note.description: Free-text note describing the action taken.
note.example: Rolled back to v1.2.3 and scaled replicas back to 3.

example.note: Rolled back to v1.2.3 and scaled replicas back to 3.

200.description: Human action acknowledged. The response has `spec` and `status` but no `resourceMeta`.

post.description:
Sets `status.state=Closed` and `status.reviewedAt`; the optional body is handled as in review. When `status.requiresHumanAction=true` and the `aiops.chatcli.io/human-action-acknowledged` annotation is missing, the PostMortem reconciler reverts the closure — call `POST /postmortems/{name}/ack-human-action` first.

Minimum role: `operator`.

example.notes: All action items assigned. Root cause verified.

get.description:
Lists RemediationPlan CRs.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one RemediationPlan: `spec` is the flat item plus safety constraints, evidence, rollback info and agentic history; `status` is the raw CR status.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists AIInsight CRs.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one AIInsight: `spec` is the flat item, `status` the raw CR status.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Counters across all namespaces. `from`/`to` filter issues, remediation plans and postmortems by creation time; runbook, SLO and pending-approval counts are always totals.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Issue counts per day or ISO week (by creation time), with a severity breakdown, sorted by date. All namespaces.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Resources with the most issues in the window, sorted by count. All namespaces.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Mean time to detect per day, in seconds: `status.detectedAt − creationTimestamp` of each Issue (0 when `detectedAt` is unset), grouped by the Issue's creation day. Issues induced by a chaos experiment are left out. All namespaces.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Mean time to resolve per day, in seconds: `status.resolvedAt − creationTimestamp` for Issues in state Resolved, grouped by the Issue's creation day. Issues induced by a chaos experiment are left out. All namespaces; no severity or phase breakdown.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

One capacity forecast per distinct resource that has Issues (in the namespace, or all namespaces). Resources whose analysis fails are skipped. The window is `to − from` when both are given, else 7 days. The operator keeps no usage history: usage is the first container's requests (`UsageSource`), `Trend.Direction` is `insufficient_history`, no exhaustion date is projected, and `Urgency` is `plan` or `none`.

The items are Go structs serialized without JSON tags, so their keys are PascalCase.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

LLM spend the controllers booked per incident in the cost ledger ConfigMap `chatcli-cost-ledger`: total cost, incident count and cost per incident for the namespace and period. Without a namespace it aggregates every namespace's ledger. `from` and `to` are an absolute period (with only `to`, the 30 days ending at `to`; with neither, the last 30 days). A namespace without a ledger yet is a zero summary; any other ledger read failure returns 500.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Ledger to read. Empty aggregates every namespace.

get.description:
Compliance report with incident, remediation, SLA, approval and audit metrics. `from` and `to` are an absolute period (with only `to`, the 7 days ending at `to`; with neither, the last 7 days). With IncidentSLAs in scope, the SLA violations are the response and resolution violations their controller recorded on each Issue, and `IncidentSLAs` lists every SLA with its counters; without any, an Escalated Issue counts as a resolution violation.

Keys are PascalCase (pinned by explicit JSON tags) and durations are integers in **nanoseconds**.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Remediation outcomes grouped by primary strategy (the plan's strategy in agentic mode, otherwise the type of its first action). Each Issue counts once per strategy it used; it counts as successful when the parent Issue is Resolved. Plans whose Issue no longer exists are skipped. All namespaces.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists AuditEvent CRs, newest first. The time range applies to `spec.timestamp` (or the creation time when it is empty).

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Exports every matching AuditEvent (no pagination) as a JSON download (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=audit-events-<timestamp>.json`). Same filters as the list. JSON is the only format; there is no async job.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists ClusterRegistration CRs.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Lists the policies of one kind: approval (ApprovalPolicy), notification (NotificationPolicy), escalation (EscalationPolicy) or sla (IncidentSLA). Read-only: policies are written through kubectl or GitOps. Each item carries its raw spec and status.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Filter by namespace; empty lists every namespace.

get.description:
Returns one policy of the given kind with its raw spec and status.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Counts every ClusterRegistration (all namespaces) and returns them with the cluster list. `healthyClusters` = connected and not degraded, `degradedClusters` = connected with the Degraded condition True, `offlineClusters` = not connected.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Returns one ClusterRegistration. `spec` and `status` carry the same flat cluster object.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

All ClusterRegistrations (all namespaces), optionally filtered by tier. Not paginated: `metadata.page` is 1 and `pageSize` equals the item count.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

One entry per distinct `platform.chatcli.io/cross-cluster-correlation` annotation the federation controller wrote on Issues (first Issue seen per id; the legacy `platform.chatcli.io/correlation-id` is still read). `correlatedClusters`, `elevated` and `cascade` come from the annotations `platform.chatcli.io/affected-clusters` (legacy `correlated-clusters` still read), `platform.chatcli.io/elevated-severity` and `platform.chatcli.io/cascade-detected`. Not paginated.

Minimum role: `viewer`.

Cluster counts by `status.connected` (a ClusterRegistration without status counts as disconnected) and the number of Issues not in Resolved or Failed, across all namespaces. `GET /federation` returns the same.

Minimum role: `viewer`.
Served at the root of the API port (`/healthz`, not under `/api/v1`). Always returns 200 while the HTTP server is up. No authentication, no rate limit.
Served at the root of the API port (`/readyz`). Lists one Issue through the Kubernetes API (5 s timeout): 200 when that works, 503 with the error otherwise. No authentication, no rate limit.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the `X-API-Key` header. Keys are read from the Secret `chatcli-operator-secrets`, key `api-keys` (fallback: ConfigMap `chatcli-operator-config`, key `api-keys`) in the operator namespace, as a YAML list of `{key, role, name, description}` (`name` is the identity recorded on approval decisions); the operator chart creates it only with `apiKeys.create: true`. Roles: `viewer` < `operator` < `admin` — any other role string is denied everywhere. Changes are picked up within about 30 seconds; deleting both the Secret and the ConfigMap revokes every key. With no keys configured every `/api/` call returns 401, unless `CHATCLI_OPERATOR_DEV_MODE=true`, which grants admin without a key (development only).

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number (1-based). Invalid values fall back to 1.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Items per page. Values above 100 are capped at 100.

From.name: from
From.description: Start of the time range (RFC3339). Unparseable values are ignored.

To.name: to
To.description: End of the time range (RFC3339). Unparseable values are ignored.

NamespaceFilter.name: namespace
NamespaceFilter.description: Kubernetes namespace. Empty means all namespaces.

NamespaceSearchAll.name: namespace
NamespaceSearchAll.description: Namespace of the object. When omitted, all namespaces are searched and the first object with this name is used.

NamespaceDefault.name: namespace
NamespaceDefault.description: Namespace of the object. Defaults to `default` — pass it for objects in any other namespace.

AuditType.name: type
AuditType.description: Exact match on `spec.eventType`: issue_created, issue_resolved, issue_escalated, issue_contained, remediation_started, remediation_completed, remediation_failed, approval_requested, approval_approved, approval_rejected, approval_expired, notification_sent, slo_violation or sla_breach.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid `X-API-Key`, or no API keys configured (and dev mode off)

example.message: missing API key in X-API-Key header

Forbidden.description: The key's role is below the operation's minimum role

RateLimited.description: More than 600 requests per minute with this API key, or more than 30 per minute from this client host without a valid key

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the bucket holds a token again (1 for the key limit, 2 for the host limit).

Conflict.description: Conflict with the current state of the object (already resolved, already exists, or modified concurrently — retry)

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON body or failed field validation

MethodNotAllowed.description: Only GET is supported on this resource group

totalCount.description: Items matching the filters, before pagination.

message.example: issue not found: issue "payment-service-oom-1710860400" not found in any namespace

chaosInduced.description: True when the Issue carries the label `platform.chatcli.io/source=chaos-experiment`.

chaosExperiment.description: Value of the label `platform.chatcli.io/chaos-experiment` when chaosInduced is true.

requiresHumanAction.description: `status.requiresHumanAction`, or true when the state is Contained or the `RequiresHumanAction` condition is True.

name.description: Required on create; ignored on update.

maxAttempts.description: Defaults to 3 on create; on update only values > 0 are applied.

errorBudgetUsed.description: Used part of the budget, same unit as errorBudgetTotal: `errorBudgetTotal × status.errorBudgetConsumedPercentage / 100`.

burnRate1h.description: `status.burnRate1h` (1.0 = consuming the budget exactly on schedule).

state.description: Derived from the status: Breached when the target is missed or the budget is gone, AtRisk while a burn-rate alert fires, Healthy otherwise. Omitted before the first calculation.

burnRate.description: The controller's 1-hour burn rate (`status.burnRate1h`). The 6h, 24h and 72h rates are in SLOItem.

state.description: Healthy, AtRisk or Breached; empty before the first calculation.

action.description: Type of the first entry in `spec.requestedActions`.

decisionReason.description: Reason of the rejection, or of the last approval, from `status.decisions`.

decidedAt.description: `status.approvedAt`, `rejectedAt` or `expiredAt`, once the request is finished.

annotations.description: The ApprovalRequest annotations, including the blast radius prediction (`platform.chatcli.io/blast-radius`, `platform.chatcli.io/blast-risk-level`).

requiredApprovers.description: `spec.requiredApprovers`: distinct approvers a quorum rule needs.

approver.description: Name of the person deciding, recorded next to the identity of the API key. Required (400 when empty); control characters are dropped and it is cut at 128 characters.

notes.description: Stored in `aiops.chatcli.io/review-notes`, only together with reviewer.

requiresHumanAction.description: `status.requiresHumanAction`: the parent Issue was only Contained. Closing is reverted until the human action is acknowledged.

chaosInduced.description: True when the PostMortem carries the label `platform.chatcli.io/source=chaos-experiment`.

containedIssues.description: Issues in Contained (workload silenced, human action pending); also counted in openIssues.

remediatedIssues.description: Distinct existing Issues with at least one plan in the window.

resolvedByRemediation.description: Of those, how many are Resolved.

postMortemsRequiringHumanAction.description: PostMortems with status.requiresHumanAction=true that are not Closed.

slosAtRisk.description: SLOs whose state (derived from the SLO status, as in SLOItem) is AtRisk or Breached.

pendingApprovals.description: ApprovalRequests with empty or Pending state.

date.description: Day, or the first day of the ISO week bucket.

count.description: Number of Issues in the bucket.

CapacityForecastItem.description: Go struct without JSON tags: PascalCase keys (except Resource, whose fields have tags).

Direction.description: Always `insufficient_history`: no usage history is collected.

HistoryAvailable.description: Always false: no usage samples are collected.

Urgency.description: `plan` when requests reach 80% of limits or the resource is a bottleneck.

totalLLMCost.description: Sum of every incident's estimated LLM cost (USD) booked inside the window.

spec.description: Go struct without JSON tags: PascalCase keys; durations are integers in nanoseconds.

IncidentSLAs.description: One entry per IncidentSLA in scope; omitted when there is none.

action.description: Strategy label (plan strategy, first action type, `Agentic` or `Unknown`).

actorType.description: `controller`, or `user` for approval_approved / approval_rejected after a human decision.

actorName.description: The controller, or the approvers recorded in the ApprovalRequest `status.decisions` for a human approval decision.

timestamp.description: `spec.timestamp`, or the creation time when empty.

degraded.description: True when the cluster is connected and its Degraded condition is True (some nodes are not Ready); omitted otherwise.

healthyClusters.description: Connected clusters whose Degraded condition is not True.

degradedClusters.description: Connected clusters whose Degraded condition is True.

clusters.description: Omitted when there are no clusters.

degradedClusters.description: Connected clusters whose Degraded condition is True (also counted in connectedClusters).

totalActiveIssues.description: Issues not in Resolved or Failed, all namespaces.

correlatedClusters.description: Annotation `platform.chatcli.io/affected-clusters` (the number of clusters, as a string), or the legacy `platform.chatcli.io/correlated-clusters`.
